content: Results for the cross-target setting are given in Table TABREF37. Similar to the cross-lingual setting, M-Bert performs worse in a cross-target setting but easily surpasses the majority class baselines. Furthermore, the cross-question score of M-Bert is slightly lower than the cross-topic score.
